data.title: A pause beside the water

memoryNodes.cue: Mist makes it difficult to see the other bank.
The line keeps the boat from drifting away.

data.situation:
At the pier, a notice said the next crossing was delayed due to poor visibility. The opposite bank was hidden in mist. Lin tried to navigate using the lights across the water, then put the map away. A deckhand told her that navigation on this stretch depended on the crew’s instruments as well as what they could see. The passengers waited in the shelter. Maya: Does the river boat make you feel sick?
Lin: Sometimes. The motion is worse when I look down at my phone.
Deckhand: The boat will stay tied here until we can leave. Wind and current can cause a slow drift away from the pier. That line keeps us in place. Please wait behind the barrier.
Lin: I’ll put the phone in my bag and watch the bank when we start. When the mist lifted, the crew opened the barrier. The town’s clock tower had seemed to vanish for a while, though it had never moved. Now it stood clearly above the roofs. Lin stepped onto the boat with one hand on the rail. The folded map stayed in her pocket.

readingBlocks.en: At the pier, a notice said the next crossing was delayed due to poor visibility. The opposite bank was hidden in mist. Lin tried to navigate using the lights across the water, then put the map away. A deckhand told her that navigation on this stretch depended on the crew’s instruments as well as what they could see. The passengers waited in the shelter.
readingBlocks.zh: 渡口的告示说，下一班船因能见度低而延误。对岸隐在雾里。林试着借水对面的灯光辨认方向，随后收起地图。一位甲板工作人员告诉她，这一段的航行既靠船员仪器，也靠目视。乘客在候船棚里等候。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Does the river boat make you feel sick?
Lin: Sometimes. The motion is worse when I look down at my phone.
Deckhand: The boat will stay tied here until we can leave. Wind and current can cause a slow drift away from the pier. That line keeps us in place. Please wait behind the barrier.
Lin: I’ll put the phone in my bag and watch the bank when we start.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：乘河船会让你晕吗？
林：有时候。低头看手机时，晃动更难受。
工作人员：能出发之前，船会一直系在这里。风和水流会使船缓慢漂离码头。那根绳子让我们留在原位。请在护栏后等。
林：我会把手机放包里，出发时看着岸边。

readingBlocks.en: When the mist lifted, the crew opened the barrier. The town’s clock tower had seemed to vanish for a while, though it had never moved. Now it stood clearly above the roofs. Lin stepped onto the boat with one hand on the rail. The folded map stayed in her pocket.
readingBlocks.zh: 雾散后，船员打开护栏。刚才钟楼像是消失了一阵，虽然它从未移动。现在，它清楚地立在屋顶上方。林一手扶栏走上船，折好的地图仍留在口袋里。

glossary.zh: 能看清周围物体的程度；能见度
glossary.note: 天气与航行中的能见度；poor/good visibility。

externalEvidence.definition: quality or fact or degree of being visible; perceptible by the eye or obvious to the eye

glossary.note: due to + 名词或名词短语；本句引出原因。
glossary.example: The crossing is delayed due to poor visibility.
glossary.exampleZh: 渡河因能见度低而延误。

glossary.zh: 辨认并确定行进路线；导航
glossary.note: 本句为寻找路线；navigate a difficult situation等比喻用法另有对象。
glossary.example: Lin tries to navigate using the lights across the water.
glossary.exampleZh: 林试着借水对面的灯光辨认路线。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · navigate
externalEvidence.findingZh: 本句寻找路线的动词用法；与本地WordNet限定载具领航的定义不完全相同。

glossary.zh: 确定并引导航行路线的过程；导航
glossary.note: 过程名词，涉及确定位置、方向和路线；不指导航员本人。
glossary.example: Navigation on this stretch depends on the crew’s instruments.
glossary.exampleZh: 这一段的航行导航依靠船员仪器。

externalEvidence.definition: the guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place

glossary.zh: 移动或运动的过程；晃动
glossary.note: 不可数运动名词；议会动议用法另作语境。
glossary.example: The motion of the boat makes Lin feel sick.

externalEvidence.definition: a change of position that does not entail a change of location

glossary.zh: 受水流或风推动的缓慢漂移
glossary.note: 此处用名词drift表示漂移；动词可说the boat drifts。
glossary.example: Wind and current can cause a slow drift away from the pier.
glossary.exampleZh: 风和水流会使船缓慢漂离码头。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · drift_2
externalEvidence.findingZh: 缓慢持续的位置变化；保留原名词字段与漂移动词例句的冲突。

glossary.zh: 突然或逐渐从视野中消失
glossary.note: 不及物动词，本句为看不见；不是钟楼真的被移走。
glossary.example: The tower seems to vanish in the mist.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the delay and the weather condition behind it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 解释延误及背后的天气条件。
acceptableAnswers: The crossing is delayed due to poor visibility.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain what Lin is trying to do with the distant lights and what the crew uses.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 解释林想借远处灯光做什么，以及船员用什么。
acceptableAnswers: Lin tries to navigate using the lights. The crew uses instruments for navigation.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Describe what makes Lin uncomfortable and why the boat is tied to the pier.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 描述什么让林不舒服，以及为何将船系在码头。
acceptableAnswers: The boat’s motion makes her feel sick. Wind and current can cause a slow drift, so the boat is tied to the pier.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: Fog hides a familiar building during a walk. Describe what seems to happen without saying it was destroyed.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 散步时，雾遮住一座熟悉的建筑。描述看起来发生了什么，不说它被毁。
acceptableAnswers: The building seems to vanish in the mist. Visibility is poor.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
